Native Salesforce anonymous Apex and named tests at matching source and transport API 62.0 and 67.0. Each one-line anonymous wrapper or named method calls the captured TraceProbe.capture method, which invokes TraceLeaf.fail and returns the caught exception's type, message, cause, line number and stack. org.tsv rows 2–29 retain seven non-trigger exception cases on anonymous and named-test routes; message and stack columns are base64 UTF-8, with N denoting null. The exact class sources are retained to preserve lines. Trigger-induced failures were captured separately; this table does not represent them.
